facebook.content:
“Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your rule endures through all generations.” — Psalm 145:13  

The Kingdom isn’t a future hope; it’s a present authority that flows through every decision you make. When you submit your plans to the One who reigns eternally, the world’s shifting standards lose their grip and God’s order takes command.  

What area of your life will you hand over to the King today?

instagram.content:
“**Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.**” — Matt 24:35  
The Kingdom stands on Christ’s unshakable decree, not on our shifting circumstances. Every decision you face today is measured against that eternal standard.  

What truth from this verse is you must declare over your life right now?
